Q.36 In the answer to Q.33 you have stated that MVP Consults have received
consultancy services from M/s SPCPL and bills have been raised against
services such as Proof Checking, Planning, Coordinating etc. So please
explain does MVP Consulates have any specific unit and technical staff in
this office or any other office of MVP Consults to provide these
services. Further are there any co-ordinating staff or any kind of other
staff to provide these services to M/s SPCPL. Also prove the
quantification of consultancy services provided by MVP to M/s SPCPL
in the last six years.

Ans To the best of my knowledge there is no technical and co-ordinating staff of
any kind in MVP Consulates to provide these services. Shri MVP will be able to
elaborate how these services are provided to M/s SPCPL. Further I do not
have any kind of evidence regarding whether these services have been
actually provided or not. I only raise the bills for these services as per verbal
and telephonic directions of Shri MVP. There are no other documentary
proof other than these bills regarding the consultancy services provided by
MVP Consults to M/s SPCPL in this office. I am providing the ledgers of M/s
SPCPL in the books of M/s MVP Consults which shows the consultancy
income received by M/s MVP Consults as Exhibit-6 of this statement. The
consultancy income in respective F.Ys is as per the table below:

bills/invoices with no technical or other staff employed by him. Several incriminating

associates during search operations which show siphoning off of funds and cash
generation by several major infrastructure companies. Delivery of such cash to you
has also been unearthed during the course of search. These issues are being
discussed in the paragraphs below:

## 7.0. Delivery of cash to Shri. Chandra Babu Naidu

happened between you and him.

**Ans** I met with Mr Srinivas in August 2016 for the first time while being the part of Foxconn team which visited Andhra Pradesh. Post that, there was some courtesy visit to him in 2017 and 2018 as I was looking at the various aspects of SPCL as their consultant. In the Mid of February 2019, I was asked to come to Vijaywada and Srinivas asked me for party funds for TDP as the elections was approaching. Chandra Babu Naidu Ex CM of Andhra Pradesh. Also, state the
nature of conversation happened between you and him.

**Ans** I met up with Sh. Chandra Babu Naidu, the Ex. CM of Andhra
Pradesh in our various presentations and meetings held at Interim
Secretariat for the ongoing process of the work/projects like APTIDCO
(In Feb 2017 ShahpoorjiPullonji received the first order of Book order
was for 1,40,000 homes but had completed only 23.000 homes in
March 2019). EWS Housing, the development of the High Court, the
Head of the Department buildings and other infrastructure
developments in the capital region of Amravati at that time. These were
government meetings in which the entire department of APTIDCO,
APCRDA were called for along with Shapoorji Pullonji wherein even I
attended the meetings. First time I met Sh. Chandra Babu Naidu
personally, when I was asked to come to Vijaywada in mid of Feb 2019
at the CM residence. In this meeting. Sh. Chandra Babu Naidu
personally discussed the general progress of the all the work/projects
going on in SPCL at that time and asked me to meet his PS, Srinivas to
follow his instructions.........”

Secretary. Government of Andhra. The meeting was very brief but I
went back in few months to meet the secretary as I had read in the
papers that the state of Andhra had many EPC contracts coming up as
they were in a process of setting up a new capital city. Having met him
and having some brief knowledge, I approached SPCL (Shapoorji
Pallonji) Hyderabad team for the projects. Having given them the
details, they were very keen to take part in the tenders coming up in
Andhra. I then met up with the Secretary. MUAD of Andhra Pradesh,
who gave me brief knowledge for upcoming tenders. We then took part
in the first tender around December 2017, where we declared LI for a
tender of Rs 65crores for construction of Interim Secretariat. Having
secure the contract and as shapoorji team was already working with
me. I paid keen attention to ensure that the project is completed in time.

Post which having been established myself in Vijaywada as SPCL
consultant, many projects were won by us competitively bidding against
L & T, NCC and other major infrastructure companies Shapoorji
Pallonji, by December 2018 had procured orders of around Rs 8.000
crores. The Projects bagged by SPCL included-i) EWS housing project
in Kurnul, Guntur, Anantpur and west Godavari amounting to Approx Rs
7000 cr.. ii) Government housing project in Amravati for approx. Rs
700cr. In February 2019, I was called by Sh Chandra Mohan Naidu. the
then CM of Andhra at his residence. In this meeting, Sh. Chandra Babu
Naidu personally discussed the general progress of the all the
work/projects going on in SPCL at that time and asked me to meet his
PS. Srinivas to follow his instructions. I then met his PS. In this meeting.
he had asked me for the party funds minimum of Rs 100cr as the
elections were approaching. I told him that I am not the authorised
person and communicated his message to Sh. Subodh Dixit, MD of
SPCL. Initially, he said no to this demand. But after two three days, I
got a message from Srinivas that he will send me the names of
companies through one Vicky Jain to whom subcontracting work to be
given. Based on his instructions, Vicky Jain got in touch with me and
gave me the names of Naolin and Everett. One Mr Vinay Nangalia was
also introduced to me by Sh. Srinivas in March 2019. One day, I got a
call from Vinay Nangalia on the instructions of Srinivas and requested
to meet me. I met him first time in Colaba outside Shapoorji Pallonji
office where he told me that he has three companies namely
Haigreeva, Annnai and Shalakha which will be facilitating the
transactions for election funding. Accordingly, work was subcontracted
